question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

He had been improve / his communication skills in order / to shine in his career.
solution:
The correct answer is: **He had been improve**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the verb form used in the sentence.
 
• The verb "**improve**" is not correctly conjugated in the **past perfect continuous tense**.
 
• In the past perfect continuous tense, the correct structure is: subject + had been + present participle (verb + -ing)__
 
• So, the corrected part of the sentence should read: "**He had been improving**."
 
• This construction indicates an ongoing action that had been happening in the past leading up to another past event or time. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence**: *He had been improving his communication skills in order to shine in his career. *
